attestations.text: WU Ching-tzŭ 吳敬梓 (T. 敏軒, 文木), 1701–1754, Dec. 12, novelist, was a native of Ch'üan-chiao, Anhwei. His great-grandfather, Wu Kuo-tui 吳國對 (T. 玉隨, 默巖, H. 1616–1680), was a chin-shih of 1658 who held prominent posts in the Hanlin Academy.
